findings.governingReading: The arm bears the name of an angel of Hell.
findings.explanation: The English changes origin or domain into the theological category “fallen angel.”

findings.highlight: A cursed arm that creates an image of the target’s heart and swaps it with the real heart.
findings.evidenceJa: 対象の心臓とまったく同じ偶像を作り、反鏡存在とする事で実像の心臓とすり替える呪いの腕
findings.governingReading: The arm creates an idol exactly identical to the target’s heart, establishes it as a counter-mirror existence, and substitutes it for the real heart.
findings.explanation: The English omits exact identity and the counter-mirror mechanism that enables substitution.

findings.governingReading: Zouken intends Sakura’s emptied Grail body as a vehicle or vessel he can occupy.
findings.explanation: The English broadens bodily possession into using her as a tool.

findings.governingReading: The recollection is from more than ten years earlier.
findings.explanation: The English makes the open lower bound exactly ten years.

findings.highlight: one can only dream about it
findings.evidenceJa: それを夢見ない人間はいない
findings.governingReading: There is no person who does not dream of that peaceful domestic life, even if they hate it.
findings.explanation: The English changes inevitability of the dream into its remaining merely a dream or impossibility.

findings.governingReading: The man’s despair was drawing near as even this saint failed to heal him.
findings.explanation: The English changes an approaching culmination into an already established state.

findings.highlight: looked up at the man and smiled
findings.evidenceJa: 掠れていく意識で男を見上げて
findings.governingReading: With consciousness fading away, the blood-covered woman looks up and smiles.
findings.explanation: The English omits her failing consciousness.

findings.highlight: The memory of the man who feeds on others’ misfortunes.
findings.evidenceJa: 世界が穢れるほど満たされる男
findings.governingReading: The remembered man becomes more fulfilled as the world grows more corrupted.
findings.explanation: The English retains feeding on others’ misery but omits the world-scale relation between corruption and fulfillment.

findings.highlight: Nee-san, who lived without any troubles
findings.evidenceJa: わたしとは何もかも違う
findings.governingReading: Sakura condemns the sister who differs from her in every respect and has lived without hardship.
findings.explanation: The English omits the total contrast between them.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしを思い知らせてあげたら
findings.governingReading: Sakura imagines forcing everyone who failed to help her to learn what she is and feel the consequence.
findings.explanation: The English reduces retaliatory demonstration to making people notice that she exists.

findings.governingReading: Sakura smiles as though immersed in dark pleasure.
findings.explanation: The English reverses moral coloration by translating “dark” as “sacred.”

findings.evidenceJa: それは真実だったのか
findings.governingReading: The narration asks whether Kirei’s accusation is true.
findings.explanation: The English turns an open question into absolute authorial confirmation.

findings.governingReading: The shadow’s encroachment or corrosion spreads like a raging fire.
findings.explanation: The English uses the legalistic false friend “infringement,” obscuring physical magical invasion.

findings.highlight: The shadow covers the ground in an instant.
findings.governingReading: The shadow’s speed is beyond comparison with anything it displayed before.
findings.explanation: The English preserves instantaneous spread but omits the explicit escalation from prior behavior.

findings.highlight: a position where I can make anyone realize whatever I want
findings.evidenceJa: 一方的に思い知らせる立場
findings.governingReading: Sakura now claims the position of unilaterally making others experience or understand what they did to her.
findings.explanation: The English turns directed retribution into arbitrary power to make anyone realize anything.

findings.governingReading: Sakura gives a small, audible giggle.
findings.explanation: The English changes sound into a visual expression.

findings.highlight: a speck next to her total magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋の片隅につもった塵ほどの魔力
findings.governingReading: Even magical energy no greater than dust accumulated in a room’s corner still belongs to Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes an absolute miniature image into a quantity small only relative to her total power.
